Maya G: Hey team — quick calendar question. Welcome session says 10:00 AM PT on my invite but the welcome email listed 9:30 PT. Which is correct?
Jamal R: I think there was a last-minute tweak. I saw two invites floating around.
Maya G: Also my calendar shows the event in my local timezone as 1:00 AM (next day) — I'm in IST. Pretty sure that's wrong for me? :confused:
Sarah P: Sorry about the confusion — we had to shift by 30m to accommodate a presenter. The canonical time is 9:30 AM PT. I'll fix the master invite now.
Maya G: Thanks — would you mind re‑sending an updated .ics? Google Calendar is still stuck on the old one for me.
Sarah P: Yep, uploading a corrected .ics and resending now. Also adding explicit timezone text to the description so it shows correctly across calendars.
IT Support: FYI if you use Outlook desktop you might need to remove the old invite then re-add the new .ics to force the timezone update.
Maya G: Good call, I unaccepted the old one and re-imported the new .ics — looks right now.
Jamal R: For anyone in APAC who can't make the live session — we're recording and will post it. Onboard-bot: Recording will be available in #new-hires within 24h and retained for 60 days.
Maya G: Awesome. One more thing — the Zoom link in the event details shows a join-by-phone entry only for some reason. Can someone paste the direct join link + passcode?
Sarah P: Pasting the meeting info here so nobody has to dig:
```
Join Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210
Passcode: Rwd2026
Dial-in: +1 669 900 6833
```
Maya G: Perfect, thanks! Saved.
IT Support: If the passcode doesn't autofill for you, try the full link with ?pwd= parameter — that usually handles it.
Maya G: Confirmed the direct link works. One tiny thing: the calendar reminder is set to 30m; could we add a 10m as well? I forget at 30m.
Sarah P: Done — added a second 10m popup for the event.
Jamal R: Heads-up for US folks: if you're on the mobile app check the event timezone settings under event details — sometimes mobile shows floating TZs differently.
Maya G: All set, I can see 9:30 AM PT now and the 10m reminder. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
